text:
alex: Heads up — GalaxyPulse sent an updated case study + new logo kit for the marketplace listing and joint solution brief. Need quick reviews on logos (SVG/PNG + on-dark/light), copy/tagline change, and one edited customer quote. Files: https://files.galaxypulse.co/rdw/case-study-v2.pdf and https://drive/repo/GalaxyPulse-logo-pack-2026.zip. Can design / legal / marketing weigh in? Need final assets by EOD Friday for marketplace publish. @sam @devon @maria :eyes:

sam: Downloaded the zip — SVGs present but the white-mark variant looks rasterized at small sizes (see attached). Their "GP" mark has thin strokes not aligned to pixel grid; we'll get weird artifacts on the marketplace tile. Can we ask for a cleaned vector (24px grid) and a 3x transparent PNG? Also no clear do-not-crop or clearspace table in their brand guide. I'll mock two hero lockups for the solution brief and a marketplace tile option. :mag:

maria: Quick marketing note — they changed their tagline to "AI that listens" in the new brief. Do we want to mirror that or keep our phrasing more developer-focused? If we modify partner copy (or the customer quote) we'll need explicit approval. They provided FR/DE translations but formatting has line breaks in odd places — localization team should QC. cc @tia

tia: I can ping the customer contact tomorrow to confirm quote permission and whether they approve the tagline swap in downstream co-marketing. For the solution brief, keep the technical callouts (dedicated inference capacity, latency SLOs). I'll also ask if they can provide a short 1-2 sentence customer blurb specific to the joint brief.

devon: Quick legal read — they replaced "pilot" with "production" in the customer quote, that's a material change; we need signed permission if the meaning shifts. They included a TM usage note for GalaxyPulse in the EU section; looks fine but I'll provide redlines for the logo usage snippet and a one-line trademark blurb to include on the marketplace tile. Will aim to send redlines by 12:30p.

sam: Screenshot + notes: https://imgur.com/placeholder (pixelated_small.png). Asking partner for: clean SVG (stroke-aligned), transparent PNG @2x/@3x, and a 600x600 PNG for marketplace preview. Also request a short usage table: background treatments, min-size, clearspace, alt text examples.

alex: Action items recap — sam: request vector fixes & 2x/3x PN G to partner; devon: redlines + trademark blurb; tia: confirm customer quote permission & approve tagline; maria: QC FR/DE formatting and give guidance for localized CTAs. Deadline: EOD Friday for bundle to publishing. If anyone can't meet, flag now. :thumbsup:

sam: Suggested alt text block to include in the asset pack:
```
logo_alt: "GalaxyPulse logo — partner"
tile_alt: "GalaxyPulse + Redwood Inference co-branded marketplace tile"
case_study_pdf_alt: "GalaxyPulse case study with Redwood Inference — production inference at scale"
```

maria: Noted — I'll also prepare a short variant of the marketplace blurb that keeps our developer-forward language and offers a partner-approved short line. Will share copy in this thread when ready. :spiral_note_pad:

devon: Sending legal redlines now (PDF). If partner signs the quote permission with the production wording, we can proceed. Otherwise we'll revert to original language in the case study.

tia: I can get confirmation by tomorrow afternoon; if approved I'll post the signed note here.

alex: thanks team. Let's aim for quick back-and-forth — no need for a long review meeting unless the partner pushes back. :rocket:
